description: This file defines the CameraActivity class which extends Android's Activity class. It sets up the activity's layout and initiates a fragment transaction to display a camera interface using Camera2VideoFragment.

classes.name: CameraActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages the camera interface, setting up the layout and embedding Camera2VideoFragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches the Camera2VideoFragment if no previous state exists.
